name: CohesiveMechanism
summary: Separates a self-contained piece of machinery — an algorithm, a formalism, a solver — from the model that needs it, so that the model states what it wants and not how the answer is computed.

roles.name: CohesiveMechanism
roles.summary: Machinery factored out of the model and exposed by an interface that speaks of what it computes rather than of how. What is left behind is the point: a model that asks for the shortest route stays a model, where one that carries the search alongside its concepts no longer reads as either.
